messages:
Olivia Park: FYI — Acme Retail asked if we can onboard Falcon-2X (open weights) and pin it in eu-west and ap-southeast for their compliance + latency needs. They want an ETA and any caveats.
Maria Chen: Thanks Olivia. Quick q: is this the 'falcon-2x' family from the community release (Apache2-ish license)? any specific version tag they need pinned?
Olivia Park: They mentioned 'falcon-2x-v1.2' in their request. Sales says the customer will pay for Dedicated if we need capacity, but they'd prefer hosted if we can guarantee region availability and a short rollout.
Kevin Patel: License OK from my read, but model size and quantization options matter. Falcon-2X is ~80B — we'd need to verify 8-bit quant support and perf on our A100/MI250 pool.
Jess Ortega: Can we do a quick checklist here for product acceptance? My draft:
- model infra validated (quant + perf)
- region deployment config (eu-west, ap-southeast)
- version pinning API + console UI knobs
- rollout SLOs and fallback policy (if capacity exhausted)
- security/legal signoff
Samir Gupta: Infra note: we currently have spare Dedicated capacity in eu-west but ap-southeast is thin. If customer wants guaranteed capacity there we'd need a short procurement / burst plan or recommend cross-region with sticky routing.
Olivia Park: Sales prefers pin in both regions. Customer is ok with a canary for first 48h. They need API-level version pin (so their team can fix to v1.2) — and an agreement on fallback: auto-fallback to falcon-2x-quantized or smaller falcon-1 if load spikes?
Maria Chen: Agreed on API pin. For the console UX, we should add a checkbox "pin version to region" and a note about fallback precedence. Small copy change, will sketch.
Kevin Patel: Technical caveat: v1.2 uses a new rotary embedding tweak; our current kernel set needs an additional test to ensure correctness in 8-bit. I'll run a validation harness on a sample repo and post logs.
onboard-bot: "Validation job queued: falcon-2x-v1.2 on a100-eu-west (job id 9876). ETA ~2h."
Samir Gupta: If job passes, we can promote a model bundle to eu-west within the day. ap-southeast will need manual approval for extra nodes — estimate 3-5 business days for capacity commit.
Jess Ortega: Launch criteria proposal (final):
1) Perf >= 90% of baseline (latency p95 target 300ms for 1k tokens)
2) Inference cost within 1.4x of baseline or explicit customer ok
3) Console pin + API support implemented
4) Canary for 48h with no functional regressions on test prompts
5) Legal confirms license
Kevin Patel: I'll attach validation outputs once run. If the 8-bit path fails, next step is to test bf16 half-precision on Dedicated (cost impact noted).
Olivia Park: Great — I'll sync with the customer: offer timeline: eu-west can be live ~48h if infra checks pass, ap-southeast as "Reserved" with 3-5 day lead for capacity. Sales to confirm budget for Dedicated if needed.
Maria Chen: I'll put a small product-PRD stub in the backlog and tag it as "customer-intake/falcon-2x-acme". Assign to @Kevin and @Samir for the infra/validation bits.
Olivia Park: Thanks all. Can someone drop a short summary for the customer-facing ticket once Kevin posts validation? :thumbsup:
Kevin Patel: Will do. I expect logs in ~2h, will post summarized results and attach perf table.
Jess Ortega: I'll prep the UI copy and small mock for the pin checkbox. Pushing to the backlog after Kevin's green.
Samir Gupta: Noted. If we need to request burst nodes, I'll open a capacity request with infra and loop in finance for chargeback.
Olivia Park: Awesome — keeping this thread for updates. :rocket:
